### Elektromagnetisme

Groups: 8 · Skills: 31

[electromagnetism.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/electromagnetism.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Electric charges, currents, and magnetic fields describe related interactions; electricity and magnetism share underlying principles but begin with different observations.

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelajahi bagaimana muatan, arus listrik, dan medan magnet saling berinteraksi.

#### Konduktor dan isolator

Skills: 2

[conductorsAndInsulators.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/conductorsAndInsulators/conductorsAndInsulators.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Materials differ in how readily they permit electric charge to move; distinguish an electrical property of a material from a device's purpose.

**User-friendly description (id):** Temukan mengapa muatan lebih mudah bergerak dalam bahan tertentu daripada bahan lain.

##### Mengidentifikasi bahan penghantar listrik

[identifyElectricallyConductiveMaterials.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/conductorsAndInsulators/skills/identifyElectricallyConductiveMaterials.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine experimentally which materials complete a low-voltage circuit.

**User-friendly description (id):** Uji bahan yang menghantarkan listrik memakai rangkaian aman bertegangan rendah.

##### Mengidentifikasi bahan isolator listrik

[identifyElectricallyInsulatingMaterials.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/conductorsAndInsulators/skills/identifyElectricallyInsulatingMaterials.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine experimentally which materials impede the flow of current.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kenali bahan yang menghambat atau sangat membatasi arus listrik.

#### Arus, tegangan, dan hambatan

Skills: 5

[currentVoltageAndResistance.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/currentVoltageAndResistance/currentVoltageAndResistance.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Current describes the flow of electric charge, voltage is a potential difference, and resistance is opposition to current under specified physical conditions.

**User-friendly description (id):** Ketahui bagaimana arus, tegangan, hambatan, dan daya menggambarkan rangkaian listrik.

##### Menjelaskan arus listrik

[explainElectricCurrent.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/currentVoltageAndResistance/skills/explainElectricCurrent.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Electric current involves directed transport of charge, not merely random motion of charge carriers.

**User-friendly description (id):** Pahami arus listrik sebagai gerak muatan yang terarah.

##### Menjelaskan tegangan listrik

[explainElectricVoltage.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/currentVoltageAndResistance/skills/explainElectricVoltage.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Voltage specifies the difference in electric potential between two points and is not current itself.

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelaskan tegangan sebagai beda potensial listrik antara dua titik.

##### Menjelaskan daya listrik

[explainElectricalPower.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/currentVoltageAndResistance/skills/explainElectricalPower.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Electrical power describes the rate of electrical energy transfer or transformation.

**User-friendly description (id):** Pahami daya listrik sebagai laju perpindahan energi.

##### Menjelaskan hambatan listrik

[explainElectricalResistance.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/currentVoltageAndResistance/skills/explainElectricalResistance.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Resistance determines the relationship between voltage and current under given conditions and depends on conductor material and geometry.

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelajahi bagaimana hambatan memengaruhi arus pada kondisi tertentu.

##### Menjelaskan hukum Ohm untuk penghantar ohmik

[explainOhmsLawForAnOhmicConductor.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/currentVoltageAndResistance/skills/explainOhmsLawForAnOhmicConductor.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Under constant conditions, the current through an ohmic conductor is directly proportional to voltage; this law does not describe every component without exception.

**User-friendly description (id):** Gunakan hukum Ohm pada konduktor ohmik dalam kondisi tetap.

#### Medan listrik dan magnet

Skills: 3

[electricAndMagneticFields.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/electricAndMagneticFields/electricAndMagneticFields.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Fields describe interactions involving electric charges and magnetic systems without direct contact, but their physical effects differ.

**User-friendly description (id):** Ketahui bagaimana medan listrik dan magnet menghasilkan jenis gaya yang berbeda.

##### Membedakan medan listrik dan medan magnet

[distinguishElectricFromMagneticFields.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/electricAndMagneticFields/skills/distinguishElectricFromMagneticFields.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** An electric field can act on a stationary charge, whereas the magnetic component of the force on a charge depends on its motion.

**User-friendly description (id):** Bedakan gaya listrik pada muatan diam dari gaya magnet pada muatan bergerak.

##### Menjelaskan medan listrik

[explainTheElectricField.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/electricAndMagneticFields/skills/explainTheElectricField.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** An electric field determines the force on an electric charge and exists independently of a test charge.

**User-friendly description (id):** Pahami bagaimana medan listrik memengaruhi muatan tanpa kontak langsung.

##### Menjelaskan medan magnet

[explainTheMagneticField.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/electricAndMagneticFields/skills/explainTheMagneticField.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A magnetic field can act on moving charges and magnetic systems; the direction and magnitude of its effects depend on conditions.

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelaskan bagaimana medan magnet memengaruhi muatan bergerak dan benda magnetik.

#### Muatan dan interaksi listrik

Skills: 3

[electricChargesAndInteractions.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/electricChargesAndInteractions/electricChargesAndInteractions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Electrification, interactions between charged bodies, and charge transfer obey conservation of electric charge. Electric interaction can occur without direct contact.

**User-friendly description (id):** Ketahui bagaimana muatan listrik berpindah dan menghasilkan gaya.

##### Membedakan tarik-menarik dan tolak-menolak muatan listrik

[distinguishAttractionFromRepulsionBetweenElectricCharges.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/electricChargesAndInteractions/skills/distinguishAttractionFromRepulsionBetweenElectricCharges.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Like charges repel and unlike charges attract; electric interaction is distinct from magnetic interaction.

**User-friendly description (id):** Bedakan tarikan muatan berlawanan dari tolakan muatan sejenis.

##### Menjelaskan kekekalan muatan listrik

[explainConservationOfElectricCharge.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/electricChargesAndInteractions/skills/explainConservationOfElectricCharge.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The total charge of an isolated system is conserved during charge transfer and physical interactions.

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelaskan mengapa jumlah muatan listrik tetap saat muatan berpindah.

##### Mengenali pengisian muatan akibat gesekan

[recognizeTheChargingOfObjectsByFriction.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/electricChargesAndInteractions/skills/recognizeTheChargingOfObjectsByFriction.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Using a safe balloon or comb model, connect friction with electrostatic effects rather than attributing them to magnetic attraction.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kenali bagaimana menggosok benda tertentu menghasilkan gejala elektrostatis.

#### Rangkaian listrik

Skills: 9

[electricCircuits.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/electricCircuits/electricCircuits.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** An electric circuit needs a conducting path, a source, and components whose interactions determine the operation of a safe model.

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelajahi bagaimana sumber, sakelar, dan beban bekerja sama dalam rangkaian sederhana.

##### Menjelaskan rangkaian terbuka

[explainAnOpenCircuit.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/electricCircuits/skills/explainAnOpenCircuit.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Opening a branch interrupts its conducting path; in a circuit with parallel branches, other parts may continue to operate.

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelaskan apa yang terjadi ketika jalur arus terputus.

##### Menjelaskan keseimbangan arus di simpul rangkaian

[explainCurrentBalanceAtACircuitNode.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/electricCircuits/skills/explainCurrentBalanceAtACircuitNode.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Under steady current, charge does not accumulate at a node; the total current entering equals the total current leaving.

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelaskan mengapa arus yang masuk ke simpul dalam keadaan tunak sama dengan arus yang keluar.

##### Menjelaskan sambungan paralel komponen rangkaian

[explainParallelConnectionsOfElectricCircuitComponents.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/electricCircuits/skills/explainParallelConnectionsOfElectricCircuitComponents.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Parallel branches connect to the same two nodes, so each has the same voltage and the total current is divided among the branches. Opening one branch does not necessarily stop current in the others.

**User-friendly description (id):** Pahami bagaimana cabang paralel memiliki tegangan sama dan membagi arus.

##### Menjelaskan sambungan seri komponen rangkaian

[explainSeriesConnectionsOfElectricCircuitComponents.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/electricCircuits/skills/explainSeriesConnectionsOfElectricCircuitComponents.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Components connected in series share a common current path: the same current passes through each, and the total voltage across the combination is the sum of the voltages across the individual components. Breaking the single path stops current through all those components.

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelajahi bagaimana komponen pada satu jalur dialiri arus yang sama dalam rangkaian seri.

##### Mengidentifikasi pemakai energi listrik

[identifyAConsumerOfElectricalEnergy.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/electricCircuits/skills/identifyAConsumerOfElectricalEnergy.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** An electrical load converts received electrical energy into thermal, mechanical, light, or other forms, rather than merely "using current."

**User-friendly description (id):** Kenali beban yang mengubah energi listrik menjadi bentuk lain.

##### Mengidentifikasi sumber energi listrik

[identifyAnElectricalPowerSource.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/electricCircuits/skills/identifyAnElectricalPowerSource.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A source maintains a potential difference between its terminals and converts other forms of energy into electrical energy, unlike a passive conductor.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kenali komponen yang mempertahankan beda potensial dalam rangkaian.

##### Mengidentifikasi fungsi sakelar

[identifyTheFunctionOfASwitch.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/electricCircuits/skills/identifyTheFunctionOfASwitch.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A switch changes the state of a conducting path and can interrupt current in a particular branch, but it is not itself an energy source.

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelaskan bagaimana sakelar menyambung atau memutus jalur arus.

##### Memprediksi pengaruh sakelar pada rangkaian

[predictTheEffectOfASwitchInACircuit.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/electricCircuits/skills/predictTheEffectOfASwitchInACircuit.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The consequences of switching depend on where the switch is placed relative to the source, loads, and parallel paths.

**User-friendly description (id):** Perkirakan bagian rangkaian mana yang menyala atau mati akibat sakelar.

##### Mengenali rangkaian listrik tertutup

[recognizeAClosedElectricCircuit.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/electricCircuits/skills/recognizeAClosedElectricCircuit.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A closed circuit has a continuous conducting path; sustained current also requires a source of electromotive force.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kenali rangkaian yang memiliki jalur penghantar tersambung terus.

#### Elektromagnet dan induksi

Skills: 2

[electromagnetsAndInduction.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/electromagnetsAndInduction/electromagnetsAndInduction.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Electric current can create a magnetic field, and changing magnetic conditions can produce electrical effects, explaining many systems.

**User-friendly description (id):** Ketahui bagaimana arus menimbulkan medan magnet dan perubahan medan menginduksi arus listrik.

##### Menjelaskan timbulnya arus induksi

[explainHowInducedCurrentArises.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/electromagnetsAndInduction/skills/explainHowInducedCurrentArises.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A changing magnetic flux through a closed conducting loop can induce an electromotive force and current; constant flux by itself does not generate current.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kenali kapan perubahan fluks magnet menghasilkan arus induksi.

##### Menjelaskan efek magnet arus listrik

[explainTheMagneticEffectOfElectricCurrent.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/electromagnetsAndInduction/skills/explainTheMagneticEffectOfElectricCurrent.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Moving electric charges create a magnetic field; changing the current changes the field it produces and the associated magnetic interactions.

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelaskan mengapa arus listrik menghasilkan medan magnet.

#### Efek magnet dalam sistem fisik

Skills: 1

[magneticEffectsInPhysicalSystems.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/magneticEffectsInPhysicalSystems/magneticEffectsInPhysicalSystems.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Magnetic forces in real systems are explained by fields and material properties; choosing an engineering design belongs to Engineering.

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelajahi pengaruh medan magnet terhadap sistem fisik.

##### Menjelaskan peran fisik medan magnet dalam suatu sistem

[explainThePhysicalRoleOfAMagneticFieldInASystem.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/magneticEffectsInPhysicalSystems/skills/explainThePhysicalRoleOfAMagneticFieldInASystem.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine how magnetic interaction affects a system's motion or state without proceeding to select a technical component.

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelaskan bagaimana medan magnet memengaruhi gerak atau keadaan fisik lain.

#### Sifat dan interaksi magnet

Skills: 6

[magneticPropertiesAndInteractions.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/magneticPropertiesAndInteractions/magneticPropertiesAndInteractions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Materials and pole orientation affect interactions; direct contact between magnets is not required.

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelajahi interaksi antara bahan magnet dan kutub magnet.

##### Mengelompokkan benda berdasarkan interaksi magnet

[classifyObjectsByMagneticInteraction.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/magneticPropertiesAndInteractions/skills/classifyObjectsByMagneticInteraction.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Classification is based on the direction and magnitude of a material's magnetic response under relevant conditions; this is not the same as determining whether it has its own magnetic field.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kelompokkan benda menurut respons magnet yang ditunjukkannya.

##### Menjelaskan gaya magnet tanpa sentuhan

[explainMagneticActionWithoutContact.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/magneticPropertiesAndInteractions/skills/explainMagneticActionWithoutContact.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize magnetic force as an interaction that does not require direct contact.

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelaskan mengapa magnet dapat mengerahkan gaya tanpa menyentuh benda.

##### Mengidentifikasi bahan yang tertarik magnet

[identifyMaterialsAttractedToAMagnet.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/magneticPropertiesAndInteractions/skills/identifyMaterialsAttractedToAMagnet.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The observable effect of a magnetic field on a material depends on its magnetic properties; not all metals are attracted equally.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kenali bahan yang memberikan respons kuat terhadap medan magnet.

##### Memprediksi interaksi antarkutub magnet

[predictInteractionsBetweenMagneticPoles.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/magneticPropertiesAndInteractions/skills/predictInteractionsBetweenMagneticPoles.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine attraction or repulsion from a known arrangement of poles.

**User-friendly description (id):** Perkirakan apa yang terjadi saat kutub magnet yang diketahui didekatkan.

##### Mengenali gaya tarik magnet

[recognizeMagneticAttraction.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/magneticPropertiesAndInteractions/skills/recognizeMagneticAttraction.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify a situation in which magnets move toward one another due to their interaction.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kenali situasi ketika magnet saling tarik-menarik.

##### Mengenali gaya tolak magnet

[recognizeMagneticRepulsion.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/electromagnetism/magneticPropertiesAndInteractions/skills/recognizeMagneticRepulsion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify a situation in which magnets move apart due to their interaction.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kenali situasi ketika magnet saling tolak-menolak.

### Energi

Groups: 4 · Skills: 12

[energy.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/energy/energy.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Energy is a quantity that helps describe physical changes and connect phenomena involving motion, heating, light, and electricity. The emphasis is on energy transfer, transformation, and conservation rather than arithmetic formulas.

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelajahi bagaimana energi disimpan, dipindahkan, diubah bentuknya, dan tetap kekal dalam sistem fisik.

#### Kekekalan Energi

Skills: 3

[conservationOfEnergy.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/energy/conservationOfEnergy/conservationOfEnergy.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The total energy of an isolated system is conserved even as its form or distribution among bodies changes. A decrease in energy available for useful work is not its disappearance; for an open system, exchange with the surroundings must be considered.

**User-friendly description (id):** Pahami mengapa energi total sistem terisolasi tetap kekal.

##### Menjelaskan Hukum Kekekalan Energi

[explainTheLawOfConservationOfEnergy.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/energy/conservationOfEnergy/skills/explainTheLawOfConservationOfEnergy.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The total energy of an isolated system remains unchanged; for an open system, energy exchange with the surroundings must be taken into account.

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelaskan bagaimana energi tetap kekal meski bentuk atau letaknya berubah.

##### Menjelaskan Hilangnya Energi yang Berguna

[explainTheLossOfUsefulEnergy.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/energy/conservationOfEnergy/skills/explainTheLossOfUsefulEnergy.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Dissipation into forms of energy less suitable for a particular task reduces a process's usefulness but does not violate conservation of total energy.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kenali bahwa energi yang tersebar ke bentuk kurang berguna tidak hilang.

##### Menyanggah Gagasan bahwa Energi Menghilang

[refuteTheIdeaThatEnergyDisappears.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/energy/conservationOfEnergy/skills/refuteTheIdeaThatEnergyDisappears.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify unaccounted energy transfers and transformations instead of attributing a system's change of state to energy disappearing.

**User-friendly description (id):** Temukan ke mana energi berpindah, bukan menganggapnya lenyap begitu saja.

#### Perpindahan dan Perubahan Bentuk Energi

Skills: 2

[energyTransferAndTransformation.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/energy/energyTransferAndTransformation/energyTransferAndTransformation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Energy can pass between objects and change form; the sequence of events matters more than the name of a particular device.

**User-friendly description (id):** Temukan bagaimana energi berpindah antar benda dan berubah bentuk.

##### Menjelaskan Perubahan Bentuk Energi dalam Proses Fisika

[explainEnergyTransformationInAPhysicalProcess.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/energy/energyTransferAndTransformation/skills/explainEnergyTransformationInAPhysicalProcess.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Energy changes form during physical processes, for example when energy shifts between motion and position; the total energy of an isolated system is conserved.

**User-friendly description (id):** Telusuri perubahan bentuk energi sambil memperhitungkan kekekalan energi.

##### Mengidentifikasi Perpindahan Energi Antar Benda

[identifyEnergyTransferBetweenBodies.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/energy/energyTransferAndTransformation/skills/identifyEnergyTransferBetweenBodies.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Using colliding balls or water heating, show which body transfers energy to which other body.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kenali benda mana yang memberikan energi kepada benda lain saat berinteraksi.

#### Bentuk Energi

Skills: 5

[formsOfEnergy.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/energy/formsOfEnergy/formsOfEnergy.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Motion, position, deformation, and internal state can be associated with different forms of energy; descriptions should refer to a specific physical system.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kenali berbagai bentuk energi dalam situasi fisik yang berubah.

##### Menghitung Energi Potensial Gravitasi

[calculateGravitationalPotentialEnergy.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/energy/formsOfEnergy/skills/calculateGravitationalPotentialEnergy.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine the change in a body's gravitational potential energy near Earth's surface from its mass, gravitational acceleration, and change in height, correctly accounting for the chosen reference level and units. This calculation assumes an approximately uniform gravitational field and differs from calculating elastic potential energy.

**User-friendly description (id):** Hitung perubahan energi potensial gravitasi dari massa, gravitasi, dan ketinggian.

##### Mengelompokkan Bentuk Energi

[classifyFormsOfEnergy.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/energy/formsOfEnergy/skills/classifyFormsOfEnergy.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish energy of motion, energy related to bodies' positions, elastic deformation energy, and internal energy based on the physical properties of a system.

**User-friendly description (id):** Bedakan energi akibat gerak, posisi, perubahan bentuk, dan keadaan internal.

##### Membedakan Energi dari Sumbernya

[distinguishEnergyFromItsSource.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/energy/formsOfEnergy/skills/distinguishEnergyFromItsSource.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Energy characterizes the state and changes of a system, whereas a source is a body or process from which energy is transferred to another system; the source does not create it from nothing.

**User-friendly description (id):** Bedakan energi suatu sistem dari sumber yang mentransfer energi kepadanya.

##### Menjelaskan Energi Kinetik sebagai Energi Gerak

[explainKineticEnergyAsEnergyOfMotion.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/energy/formsOfEnergy/skills/explainKineticEnergyAsEnergyOfMotion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Kinetic energy is associated with a body's motion relative to a reference frame and depends on mass and speed, but it is not the same as momentum.

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelaskan bagaimana massa dan kecepatan benda bergerak memengaruhi energi kinetiknya.

##### Menjelaskan Energi Potensial

[explainPotentialEnergy.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/energy/formsOfEnergy/skills/explainPotentialEnergy.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Potential energy is related to a physical system's configuration and interactions among its components, including bodies' positions in a gravitational field or elastic deformation. Its value is specified relative to a chosen zero level; this competency addresses physical meaning rather than calculation.

**User-friendly description (id):** Pahami energi potensial berkaitan dengan konfigurasi dan tingkat acuan terpilih.

#### Usaha dan Daya

Skills: 2

[workAndPower.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/energy/workAndPower/workAndPower.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Work describes energy transfer by a force during displacement, while power describes the rate of energy transfer.

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelajahi arti fisika dari usaha mekanis dan daya.

##### Menjelaskan Usaha Mekanis

[explainMechanicalWork.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/energy/workAndPower/skills/explainMechanicalWork.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Mechanical work involves the component of force along displacement; exerting force without displacement does not perform mechanical work.

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelaskan mengapa gaya memindahkan energi melalui perpindahan posisi.

##### Menjelaskan Arti Fisika dari Daya

[explainThePhysicalMeaningOfPower.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/energy/workAndPower/skills/explainThePhysicalMeaningOfPower.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Power describes the rate of doing work or transferring energy and is not a separate form of energy.

**User-friendly description (id):** Pahami daya sebagai laju perpindahan energi atau usaha yang dilakukan.

### Mekanika Fluida

Groups: 4 · Skills: 15

[fluidMechanics.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/fluidMechanics/fluidMechanics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Water and air transmit pressure, flow, resist bodies' motion, and can provide buoyancy. Familiar containers, floating objects, and airflow make these phenomena accessible.

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelajahi bagaimana cairan dan gas mengalir, memberikan tekanan, dan dapat menopang benda yang bergerak.

#### Aerodinamika

Skills: 3

[aerodynamics.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/fluidMechanics/aerodynamics/aerodynamics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Air exerts drag on moving bodies; shape and relative speed affect the interaction. Building aircraft or designing hulls are Engineering applications.

**User-friendly description (id):** Temukan bagaimana udara memengaruhi benda yang bergerak melaluinya.

##### Menjelaskan Gaya Angkat Aerodinamis

[explainAerodynamicLift.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/fluidMechanics/aerodynamics/skills/explainAerodynamicLift.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Airflow interacting with a body can produce a force perpendicular to the flow; it should not be explained solely by differences in air-path length.

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelajahi bagaimana aliran udara menghasilkan gaya angkat tanpa penjelasan keliru tentang lintasan sama panjang.

##### Menjelaskan Asal Hambatan Udara Saat Bergerak

[explainTheOriginOfAirResistanceDuringMotion.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/fluidMechanics/aerodynamics/skills/explainTheOriginOfAirResistanceDuringMotion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Using a paper sheet or ball, connect drag to the body's interaction with air; do not claim that drag arises only from an unsuitable shape.

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelaskan mengapa bergerak melalui udara menimbulkan hambatan.

##### Memperkirakan Pengaruh Bentuk pada Gerak di Udara

[predictTheEffectOfShapeOnMotionThroughAir.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/fluidMechanics/aerodynamics/skills/predictTheEffectOfShapeOnMotionThroughAir.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A body's shape and orientation affect airflow around it, drag, and, under certain conditions, lift.

**User-friendly description (id):** Perkirakan bagaimana bentuk atau sudut benda mengubah gaya hambat dan gaya angkat.

#### Mengapung dan Gaya Apung

[floatingAndBuoyancy.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/fluidMechanics/floatingAndBuoyancy/floatingAndBuoyancy.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelajahi bagaimana massa jenis dan gaya apung menentukan apakah benda mengapung atau tenggelam.

[distinguishRisingFloatingAndSinking.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/fluidMechanics/floatingAndBuoyancy/skills/distinguishRisingFloatingAndSinking.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify three possible behaviors of safe objects in water through observation or simulation.

**User-friendly description (id):** Bedakan benda yang naik, tetap mengapung, atau tenggelam di dalam air.

##### Menjelaskan Prinsip Archimedes

[explainArchimedesPrinciple.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/fluidMechanics/floatingAndBuoyancy/skills/explainArchimedesPrinciple.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Under the relevant conditions, the buoyant force equals the weight of the volume of liquid or gas displaced by the body.

**User-friendly description (id):** Gunakan prinsip Archimedes untuk menghubungkan gaya apung dengan fluida yang dipindahkan.

[explainBuoyantForce.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/fluidMechanics/floatingAndBuoyancy/skills/explainBuoyantForce.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelaskan bagaimana perbedaan tekanan menimbulkan gaya apung ke atas.

**Methodological description (English):** Density is the mass per unit volume of a substance and helps determine the relationship between a body's properties and those of the surrounding medium.

[predictHowALoadAffectsFloating.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/fluidMechanics/floatingAndBuoyancy/skills/predictHowALoadAffectsFloating.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Increasing the mass of a load changes the buoyant force and displaced volume needed for equilibrium, so a body may become more deeply submerged.

[hydrodynamics.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/fluidMechanics/hydrodynamics/hydrodynamics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use qualitative examples to recognize why moving the same object through water and through air feels different.

#### Tekanan dalam Cairan dan Gas

[explainPressureTransmissionInAnEnclosedLiquid.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/fluidMechanics/pressureInLiquidsAndGases/skills/explainPressureTransmissionInAnEnclosedLiquid.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A pressure change applied to an enclosed liquid at rest is transmitted in every direction, unlike the variation of hydrostatic pressure with depth.

[explainWhyWaterPressureIncreasesWithDepth.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/fluidMechanics/pressureInLiquidsAndGases/skills/explainWhyWaterPressureIncreasesWithDepth.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** In a stationary liquid of constant density, pressure increases with depth because of the weight of the layers above; the container's shape alone does not determine it.

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelaskan mengapa air diam memberikan tekanan lebih besar di kedalaman yang lebih besar.

##### Mengidentifikasi Tekanan Gas dalam Contoh

[identifyGasPressureInExamples.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/fluidMechanics/pressureInLiquidsAndGases/skills/identifyGasPressureInExamples.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (id):** Kenali bagaimana gas terkurung menekan permukaan di sekitarnya.

### Gaya dan interaksi

Groups: 3 · Skills: 14

[forcesAndInteractions.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/forcesAndInteractions/forcesAndInteractions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** When bodies touch or affect one another at a distance, their motion, shape, or state of equilibrium may change. This Domain covers general concepts of force, contact, gravity, and stability; specifically magnetic and electric phenomena belong to Electromagnetism.

**User-friendly description (id):** Pelajari bagaimana gaya mengubah gerak, mengubah bentuk benda, dan menjaga kestabilan.

#### Gaya kontak dan gesekan

Skills: 5

[contactForcesAndFriction.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/forcesAndInteractions/contactForcesAndFriction/contactForcesAndFriction.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Contact can produce pushing, pulling, and friction; the direction of interaction and surface properties affect motion.

**User-friendly description (id):** Pelajari bagaimana dorongan, tarikan, dan gesekan memengaruhi benda yang saling bersentuhan.

##### Membandingkan gerak pada permukaan berbeda

**Methodological description (English):** Interactions between contacting surfaces affect friction and resistance to sliding or rolling, changing mechanical motion under otherwise similar conditions.

**User-friendly description (id):** Bandingkan gerak pada permukaan berbeda dengan mempertimbangkan gesekan.

##### Menjelaskan peran gesekan dalam menghentikan gerak

**Methodological description (English):** Friction during sliding or rolling can reduce kinetic energy of motion, converting it into the internal energy of the bodies and surroundings.

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelaskan bagaimana gesekan memperlambat gerak dan memindahkan energi ke lingkungan.

### Pengukuran

Groups: 2 · Skills: 7

[measurement.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/measurement/measurement.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Physical measurement connects an observable property to an agreed method of comparison through the choice of quantity, unit, and instrument. Its purpose is to make descriptions of phenomena reproducible without tying them to formulas or mathematics lessons.

**User-friendly description (id):** Pelajari cara fisikawan mengukur sifat dengan besaran, satuan, dan metode yang andal.

#### Alat dan metode pengukuran

Skills: 3

[instrumentsAndMeasurementMethods.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/measurement/instrumentsAndMeasurementMethods/instrumentsAndMeasurementMethods.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** An instrument's reading depends on its scale, units, and correct use; the method of obtaining data matters as much as the number itself.

**User-friendly description (id):** Pelajari bagaimana alat dan metode yang cermat membuat pengukuran fisika bermanfaat.

##### Menjelaskan mengapa pengukuran berulang dapat berbeda

[explainWhyRepeatedMeasurementsMayDiffer.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/measurement/instrumentsAndMeasurementMethods/skills/explainWhyRepeatedMeasurementsMayDiffer.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Repeated measurements can differ because of instrument precision limits, reading methods, or changing conditions; a difference in values does not always mean that the measured phenomenon has changed.

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelaskan mengapa hasil pembacaan berulang bisa berbeda meskipun mengukur benda yang sama.

##### Membaca alat ukur sederhana

**Methodological description (English):** Correctly relate the measured quantity to the position of a pointer on a scale, its units, and the zero reference; a reading has physical meaning only under the relevant measurement conditions.

**User-friendly description (id):** Baca jarum penunjuk, skala, satuan, dan acuan nol pada alat ukur dengan benar.

##### Membaca suhu pada termometer

[readTemperatureFromAThermometer.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/measurement/instrumentsAndMeasurementMethods/skills/readTemperatureFromAThermometer.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate the position of a pointer or liquid column to the temperature scale and units, accounting for the scale origin and measurement limits.

**User-friendly description (id):** Baca skala dan satuan termometer untuk menentukan suhu.

#### Besaran fisika dan satuan

Skills: 4

[physicalQuantitiesAndUnits.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/measurement/physicalQuantitiesAndUnits/physicalQuantitiesAndUnits.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A single object can be described using different quantities; comparisons of the same quantity require compatible units and observation conditions.

**User-friendly description (id):** Pelajari cara menjelaskan sifat fisik dengan pengukuran dan satuan yang tepat.

[compareMeasurementsOfTheSameQuantity.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/measurement/physicalQuantitiesAndUnits/skills/compareMeasurementsOfTheSameQuantity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Given consistent units and clearly stated conditions, determine which measured value is larger or smaller; this is physical interpretation, not arithmetic practice.

**User-friendly description (id):** Bandingkan hasil pengukuran pada kondisi dan satuan yang konsisten.

##### Membedakan besaran fisika dari satuan ukurnya

[distinguishAPhysicalQuantityFromItsUnitOfMeasurement.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/measurement/physicalQuantitiesAndUnits/skills/distinguishAPhysicalQuantityFromItsUnitOfMeasurement.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A physical quantity describes a property of a body or phenomenon, whereas a unit establishes an agreed scale for expressing it numerically; length and centimeter serve different roles.

**User-friendly description (id):** Bedakan sifat yang diukur dari satuan yang digunakan untuk menyatakannya.

[explainThePhysicalMeaningOfABodysMass.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/measurement/physicalQuantitiesAndUnits/skills/explainThePhysicalMeaningOfABodysMass.data.ts)

[selectAUnitForAFamiliarPhysicalQuantity.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/measurement/physicalQuantitiesAndUnits/skills/selectAUnitForAFamiliarPhysicalQuantity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Choose appropriate units of time, length, and mass in everyday examples without confusing a physical quantity with an object.

**User-friendly description (id):** Pilih satuan pengukuran yang sesuai untuk waktu, massa, dan panjang.

### Mekanika

Groups: 6 · Skills: 21

[mechanics.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/mechanics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Mechanics describes changes in bodies' positions over time, the inertial properties of motion, and the transmission of mechanical action through simple systems. Basic explanations of types of forces and equilibrium are assigned to the neighboring Domain.

##### Membedakan tumbukan lenting dan tidak lenting

[distinguishElasticFromInelasticCollisions.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/momentumAndCollisions/skills/distinguishElasticFromInelasticCollisions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** In an elastic collision, the system's kinetic energy is conserved; in an inelastic collision, some becomes internal energy and deformation. Momentum remains conserved in an isolated system.

**User-friendly description (id):** Bandingkan tumbukan lenting dan tidak lenting tanpa menyamakan kekekalan energi dengan kekekalan momentum.

##### Menjelaskan kekekalan momentum linear

[explainConservationOfLinearMomentum.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/momentumAndCollisions/skills/explainConservationOfLinearMomentum.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** In the absence of a net external impulse, the total momentum of a system remains constant even though individual bodies change their momenta.

**User-friendly description (id):** Pahami mengapa momentum total tetap jika tidak ada impuls dari luar.

##### Menjelaskan impuls

[explainImpulse.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/momentumAndCollisions/skills/explainImpulse.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A change in a body's momentum is related to the magnitude and duration of an applied force, which explains physical differences among braking methods.

**User-friendly description (id):** Pelajari bagaimana gaya yang bekerja selama waktu tertentu mengubah momentum.

##### Menjelaskan momentum linear

[explainLinearMomentum.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/momentumAndCollisions/skills/explainLinearMomentum.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Momentum depends on a body's mass and velocity and has a direction; equal velocities of bodies with different masses do not imply equal momentum.

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelaskan bagaimana momentum bergantung pada massa, kecepatan vektor, dan arah.

#### Hukum Newton

Skills: 3

[newtonsLaws.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/newtonsLaws/newtonsLaws.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Newton's laws establish the relationships among forces, inertia, and changes in bodies' motion in the appropriate reference frames.

**User-friendly description (id):** Pelajari bagaimana hukum Newton menghubungkan gaya dengan perubahan gerak.

##### Menjelaskan hukum pertama Newton

[explainNewtonsFirstLaw.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/newtonsLaws/skills/explainNewtonsFirstLaw.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** When the net force is zero, a body's velocity in an inertial reference frame remains constant; rest is a special case.

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelaskan mengapa resultan gaya nol berarti kecepatan tetap dalam kerangka acuan inersial.

##### Menjelaskan hukum kedua Newton

[explainNewtonsSecondLaw.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/newtonsLaws/skills/explainNewtonsSecondLaw.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A body's acceleration is determined by the net force and its mass; under the same force, bodies of different masses change velocity differently.

**User-friendly description (id):** Pelajari bagaimana gaya dan massa bersama-sama menentukan percepatan.

##### Menjelaskan hukum ketiga Newton

[explainNewtonsThirdLaw.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/newtonsLaws/skills/explainNewtonsThirdLaw.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The interaction forces between two bodies are equal in magnitude and opposite in direction but act on different bodies, so they do not cancel on a single body.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kenali gaya interaksi sama besar dan berlawanan arah yang bekerja pada benda berbeda.

#### Gerak rotasi

Skills: 4

[rotationalMotion.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/rotationalMotion/rotationalMotion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Rotation involves torque, mass distribution, and inertial properties. Conservation of angular momentum describes a system's motion when there is no net external torque.

**User-friendly description (id):** Pelajari bagaimana gaya pemutar dan sebaran massa memengaruhi gerak rotasi.

##### Membedakan rotasi pada sumbu dari gerak melingkar

[distinguishRotationAboutAnAxisFromMotionAlongACircle.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/rotationalMotion/skills/distinguishRotationAboutAnAxisFromMotionAlongACircle.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A body's rotation about its own axis differs from the motion of its center along a circular path, during which the direction of velocity changes.

**User-friendly description (id):** Bedakan benda yang berputar pada sumbunya dari benda yang bergerak sepanjang lintasan lingkaran.

##### Menjelaskan kekekalan momentum sudut

[explainConservationOfAngularMomentum.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/rotationalMotion/skills/explainConservationOfAngularMomentum.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** In the absence of net external torque, a system's total angular momentum is conserved.

**User-friendly description (id):** Pahami mengapa momentum sudut tetap jika tidak ada torsi luar total.

##### Menjelaskan inersia rotasi

[explainRotationalInertia.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/rotationalMotion/skills/explainRotationalInertia.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The distribution of mass relative to an axis affects how rotation changes, even when the total mass is the same.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kenali bagaimana massa yang lebih jauh dari sumbu mengubah hambatan terhadap perubahan rotasi.

##### Menjelaskan torsi

[explainTorque.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/rotationalMotion/skills/explainTorque.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The turning effect of a force depends on its direction and lever arm relative to the axis, not merely on the force's magnitude.

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelaskan mengapa gaya yang sama dapat memutar benda secara berbeda bergantung pada lengan gayanya.

#### Pesawat sederhana

Skills: 4

[simpleMachines.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/simpleMachines/simpleMachines.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Levers, pulleys, wheels, and gears demonstrate the transmission of force and rotation. The focus here is on physical principles, not selecting a design or engineering a machine.

**User-friendly description (id):** Pahami bagaimana tuas, roda, katrol, dan roda gigi meneruskan gerak serta gaya.

##### Menjelaskan cara kerja tuas

[explainHowALeverWorks.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/simpleMachines/skills/explainHowALeverWorks.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A lever's mechanical advantage depends on distances between the fulcrum and the points where forces are applied; gaining force involves a corresponding change in displacement.

**User-friendly description (id):** Pelajari bagaimana tuas mengubah hubungan antara gaya dan jarak.

##### Menjelaskan cara kerja katrol

[explainHowAPulleyWorks.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/simpleMachines/skills/explainHowAPulleyWorks.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A fixed pulley changes the direction of the applied force, whereas a movable pulley can reduce the force needed by distributing the load across rope segments.

**User-friendly description (id):** Bandingkan bagaimana katrol tetap dan bergerak mengubah arah gaya atau membagi beban.

##### Menjelaskan cara kerja roda dan poros

[explainHowAWheelAndAxleWork.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/simpleMachines/skills/explainHowAWheelAndAxleWork.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The shared rotation of a wheel and axle transmits motion and changes the relationship between applied forces and displacements; a wheel can also change the nature of friction.

**User-friendly description (id):** Pahami bagaimana roda dan poros meneruskan putaran serta mengubah gaya yang diberikan.

##### Memprediksi putaran roda gigi yang saling bertaut

[predictTheRotationOfMeshedGears.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/mechanics/simpleMachines/skills/predictTheRotationOfMeshedGears.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A directly meshed pair of gears rotates in opposite directions, and the ratio of their angular velocities depends on the number of teeth.

**User-friendly description (id):** Prediksi bagaimana roda gigi yang bertaut berputar dan pengaruh jumlah gigi terhadap kecepatannya.

### Fisika Modern

Groups: 3 · Skills: 16

[modernPhysics.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/modernPhysics/modernPhysics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Models of atoms, quantum and nuclear phenomena, and spacetime explain observations not covered by classical physics alone. Younger children can encounter the concepts without mathematical formalism.

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelajahi fenomena kuantum, perubahan inti atom, dan fisika ruang-waktu.

#### Atom dan Fenomena Kuantum

Skills: 5

[atomsAndQuantumPhenomena.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/modernPhysics/atomsAndQuantumPhenomena/atomsAndQuantumPhenomena.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Atomic models and discrete packets of energy help explain light and properties of matter that cannot be described solely in terms of mechanical motion.

**User-friendly description (id):** Pelajari bagaimana struktur atom dan perilaku kuantum berbeda dari model klasik.

##### Membedakan Atom dan Komponen Utamanya

[distinguishAnAtomFromItsPrincipalComponents.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/modernPhysics/atomsAndQuantumPhenomena/skills/distinguishAnAtomFromItsPrincipalComponents.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** An atom consists of a nucleus and an electron cloud; electrons' motion and states do not correspond to literal planetary orbits.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kenali atom sebagai inti yang dikelilingi elektron dalam keadaan kuantum.

##### Menjelaskan Foton sebagai Kuantum Radiasi Elektromagnetik

[explainAPhotonAsAQuantumOfElectromagneticRadiation.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/modernPhysics/atomsAndQuantumPhenomena/skills/explainAPhotonAsAQuantumOfElectromagneticRadiation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A photon is a quantum of the electromagnetic field whose energy is related to radiation frequency; it should not be interpreted as a tiny classical ball.

**User-friendly description (id):** Pahami foton sebagai kuantum energi radiasi elektromagnetik.

##### Menjelaskan Tingkat Energi Atom yang Diskret

[explainDiscreteAtomicEnergyStates.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/modernPhysics/atomsAndQuantumPhenomena/skills/explainDiscreteAtomicEnergyStates.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Bound states of an atom have definite energies, and transitions between states involve energy absorption or emission.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kenali bahwa atom memiliki tingkat energi diskret dalam keadaan terikat.

##### Menjelaskan Emisi Cahaya oleh Atom Tereksitasi

[explainLightEmissionByAnExcitedAtom.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/modernPhysics/atomsAndQuantumPhenomena/skills/explainLightEmissionByAnExcitedAtom.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A transition of an atom between energy states may be accompanied by the emission of a photon whose energy is determined by the difference between those states.

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelaskan bagaimana atom dapat memancarkan foton ketika berpindah tingkat energi.

##### Menjelaskan Perilaku Mirip Gelombang dan Partikel pada Objek Kuantum

[explainWaveLikeAndParticleLikeBehaviorOfQuantumObjects.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/modernPhysics/atomsAndQuantumPhenomena/skills/explainWaveLikeAndParticleLikeBehaviorOfQuantumObjects.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Light and matter exhibit phenomena that cannot be exhaustively described by only a classical wave or a classical particle picture.

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelajahi mengapa objek kuantum menunjukkan perilaku mirip gelombang sekaligus mirip partikel.

#### Fenomena Nuklir

Skills: 6

[nuclearPhenomena.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/modernPhysics/nuclearPhenomena/nuclearPhenomena.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Changes in atomic nuclei differ from chemical reactions and may release energy.

**User-friendly description (id):** Pelajari bagaimana inti atom berubah dan mengapa beberapa perubahan melepaskan energi.

##### Membedakan Radiasi Alfa, Beta, dan Gama

[distinguishAlphaBetaAndGammaRadiation.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/modernPhysics/nuclearPhenomena/skills/distinguishAlphaBetaAndGammaRadiation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Alpha radiation consists of helium nuclei, beta radiation of electrons or positrons, and gamma radiation of high-energy photons.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kenali partikel alfa, partikel beta, dan foton gama.

##### Membedakan Transformasi Nuklir dan Perubahan Kimia

[distinguishNuclearTransformationFromChemicalChange.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/modernPhysics/nuclearPhenomena/skills/distinguishNuclearTransformationFromChemicalChange.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A nuclear transformation changes an atom's nucleus, whereas chemical reactions primarily change bonds and electronic structure.

**User-friendly description (id):** Bedakan perubahan di dalam inti atom dari reaksi kimia.

##### Menjelaskan Waktu Paruh

[explainHalfLife.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/modernPhysics/nuclearPhenomena/skills/explainHalfLife.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Half-life describes the statistical decline in the number of unstable nuclei in a population, not the lifetime of an individual nucleus.

**User-friendly description (id):** Pahami waktu paruh sebagai pola statistik pada banyak inti atom yang tidak stabil.

##### Menjelaskan Fisi Nuklir

[explainNuclearFission.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/modernPhysics/nuclearPhenomena/skills/explainNuclearFission.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Heavy nuclei can split into lighter fragments and release energy because of changes in binding energy.

**User-friendly description (id):** Pelajari bagaimana pembelahan inti berat dapat melepaskan energi.

##### Menjelaskan Fusi Nuklir

[explainNuclearFusion.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/modernPhysics/nuclearPhenomena/skills/explainNuclearFusion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Light nuclei can combine under suitable conditions, and changes in binding energy can lead to energy release.

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelaskan bagaimana penggabungan inti ringan dapat melepaskan energi.

##### Menjelaskan Radioaktivitas

[explainRadioactivity.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/modernPhysics/nuclearPhenomena/skills/explainRadioactivity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Unstable atomic nuclei spontaneously transform while emitting particles or energy; this is not an ordinary chemical reaction.

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelaskan bagaimana inti atom tidak stabil mengalami perubahan radioaktif.

#### Relativitas

Skills: 5

[relativity.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/modernPhysics/relativity/relativity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Special relativity describes how measurements of space and time relate to motion, while general relativity describes gravity as spacetime geometry. They should not be confused with the history of astronomy or require formulas in an introductory curriculum.

**User-friendly description (id):** Pelajari bagaimana gerak dan gravitasi memengaruhi pengukuran ruang dan waktu.

##### Menjelaskan Gravitasi sebagai Kelengkungan Ruang-Waktu

[explainGravityAsSpacetimeCurvature.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/modernPhysics/relativity/skills/explainGravityAsSpacetimeCurvature.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize the general relativity concept that the distribution of mass and energy affects spacetime geometry; do not treat a rubber-sheet-and-ball analogy as a literal mechanism of gravity.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kenali gravitasi sebagai akibat ruang-waktu melengkung dalam relativitas umum.

##### Menjelaskan Pengaruh Gerak Relatif Pengamat pada Berlalunya Waktu

[explainHowThePassageOfTimeDependsOnObserversRelativeMotion.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/modernPhysics/relativity/skills/explainHowThePassageOfTimeDependsOnObserversRelativeMotion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Using a conceptual model, explain why observers moving relative to one another may measure a time interval differently; this is a physical principle, not an animation-use skill.

**User-friendly description (id):** Pelajari mengapa pengamat yang bergerak relatif dapat mengukur selang waktu berbeda.

##### Menjelaskan Pengaruh Gravitasi pada Berlalunya Waktu

[explainTheEffectOfGravityOnThePassageOfTime.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/modernPhysics/relativity/skills/explainTheEffectOfGravityOnThePassageOfTime.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The relative rates of clocks can depend on gravitational potential and observation conditions; this is a physical effect of general relativity.

**User-friendly description (id):** Pelajari bagaimana gravitasi dapat mengubah laju relatif jam.

##### Menjelaskan Pembelokan Cahaya oleh Gravitasi

[explainTheGravitationalDeflectionOfLight.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/modernPhysics/relativity/skills/explainTheGravitationalDeflectionOfLight.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Near massive bodies, spacetime geometry changes light trajectories; this is not refraction at the boundary of two optical media.

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelaskan bagaimana gravitasi membelokkan lintasan cahaya tanpa pembiasan optik biasa.

##### Mengenali Ketetapan Kecepatan Cahaya dalam Vakum sebagai Prinsip Relativitas Khusus

[recognizeTheConstancyOfTheSpeedOfLightInVacuumAsAPrincipleOfSpecialRelativity.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/modernPhysics/relativity/skills/recognizeTheConstancyOfTheSpeedOfLightInVacuumAsAPrincipleOfSpecialRelativity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Using qualitative models, distinguish the invariant speed of light in vacuum for inertial observers from ordinary addition of speeds of everyday objects.

**User-friendly description (id):** Pahami bahwa kecepatan cahaya dalam vakum tetap sama bagi semua pengamat inersial dalam relativitas khusus.

### Fisika molekuler

Groups: 3 · Skills: 10

[molecularPhysics.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/molecularPhysics/molecularPhysics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Particle models help explain physical properties and changes in states of matter. Unlike chemistry, this Domain focuses on particle movement, interactions, and arrangement rather than chemical reactions.

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelajahi bagaimana gerakan dan susunan partikel menjelaskan perilaku materi.

#### Difusi dan pencampuran

Skills: 1

[diffusionAndMixing.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/molecularPhysics/diffusionAndMixing/diffusionAndMixing.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Random thermal motion can cause particles to spread gradually without deliberate stirring.

**User-friendly description (id):** Ketahui bagaimana gerakan acak partikel membuat zat menyebar dan bercampur.

##### Menjelaskan difusi

[explainDiffusion.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/molecularPhysics/diffusionAndMixing/skills/explainDiffusion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Diffusion results from particles' thermal motion and the gradual equalization of their concentrations without the need for macroscopic mixing.

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelaskan bagaimana difusi dapat terjadi tanpa pengadukan.

#### Sifat gas

Skills: 2

[gasProperties.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/molecularPhysics/gasProperties/gasProperties.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The compressibility of gases and the dependence of their pressure on conditions follow from particle motion and the spaces between particles.

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelajahi sifat fisik gas menggunakan model partikel.

##### Menjelaskan kemampatan gas

[explainGasCompressibility.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/molecularPhysics/gasProperties/skills/explainGasCompressibility.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compressing a gas reduces the average distances between particles while the sizes of the molecules remain virtually unchanged.

**User-friendly description (id):** Pahami mengapa gas dapat dimampatkan ke volume yang lebih kecil.

##### Menjelaskan hubungan tekanan gas dan suhu pada volume tetap

[explainHowGasPressureDependsOnTemperatureAtConstantVolume.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/molecularPhysics/gasProperties/skills/explainHowGasPressureDependsOnTemperatureAtConstantVolume.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** At constant volume, increasing a gas's temperature generally increases its pressure because the particles move more vigorously.

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelaskan mengapa tekanan gas meningkat saat suhu naik jika volumenya tetap.

#### Model partikel materi

Skills: 7

[particleModelOfMatter.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/molecularPhysics/particleModelOfMatter/particleModelOfMatter.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Substances consist of particles with spaces and interactions between them; the model explains properties without requiring complex formulas.

**User-friendly description (id):** Pelajari bagaimana partikel tak terlihat berinteraksi membentuk zat.

##### Membandingkan susunan partikel pada padat, cair, dan gas

[compareParticleArrangementsInSolidsLiquidsAndGases.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/molecularPhysics/particleModelOfMatter/skills/compareParticleArrangementsInSolidsLiquidsAndGases.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Particles in solids mostly oscillate around fixed positions; in liquids, particles can move relative to one another; and in gases they have much greater freedom of movement and characteristic interparticle distances.

**User-friendly description (id):** Bandingkan susunan partikel dalam zat padat, cair, dan gas.

##### Menjelaskan tekanan gas melalui gerakan partikel

[explainGasPressureThroughParticleMotion.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/molecularPhysics/particleModelOfMatter/skills/explainGasPressureThroughParticleMotion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The combined collisions of particles with the vessel walls produce force per unit area, that is, pressure.

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelaskan bagaimana banyak tumbukan partikel pada dinding wadah menghasilkan tekanan.

##### Menjelaskan gerak termal acak partikel

[explainRandomThermalMotionOfParticles.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/molecularPhysics/particleModelOfMatter/skills/explainRandomThermalMotionOfParticles.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Particles of matter are constantly moving, but not all at the same speed; the type of motion depends on the physical state.

**User-friendly description (id):** Pahami mengapa partikel terus bergerak dengan beragam cara dan kecepatan.

##### Menjelaskan struktur partikel materi

[explainTheParticulateStructureOfMatter.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/molecularPhysics/particleModelOfMatter/skills/explainTheParticulateStructureOfMatter.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Demonstrate that even water in a transparent glass consists of particles invisible to the naked eye.

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelaskan mengapa materi tersusun dari partikel yang terlalu kecil untuk dilihat langsung.

##### Menjelaskan sifat wujud materi melalui gerakan partikel

[explainThePropertiesOfStatesOfMatterThroughParticleMotion.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/molecularPhysics/particleModelOfMatter/skills/explainThePropertiesOfStatesOfMatterThroughParticleMotion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Differences in the arrangement, motion, and interactions of particles explain the properties of solids, liquids, and gases.

**User-friendly description (id):** Gunakan gerak dan interaksi partikel untuk menjelaskan sifat zat padat, cair, dan gas.

##### Menjelaskan pemuaian termal melalui gerak dan interaksi partikel

[explainThermalExpansionThroughParticleMotionAndInteractions.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/molecularPhysics/particleModelOfMatter/skills/explainThermalExpansionThroughParticleMotionAndInteractions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Heating often changes the average distances between particles, not the sizes of the molecules themselves.

**User-friendly description (id):** Pahami mengapa pemuaian biasanya mengubah jarak antarpartikel, bukan ukuran partikelnya.

##### Menghubungkan gerak partikel dengan perubahan suhu

[relateParticleMotionToTemperatureChanges.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/molecularPhysics/particleModelOfMatter/skills/relateParticleMotionToTemperatureChanges.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Using an animation, explain why average particle motion generally becomes more vigorous when heated.

**User-friendly description (id):** Hubungkan pemanasan dengan perubahan gerakan khas partikel.

### Optika

Groups: 5 · Skills: 11

[optics.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/optics/optics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Optics studies the propagation of light, image formation, and the interaction of light rays with surfaces, water, and lenses. The broader electromagnetic radiation spectrum is classified separately.

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelajahi bagaimana cahaya tampak merambat, dipantulkan, dibiaskan, dan membentuk bayangan optik.

#### Cahaya dan Bayangan

Skills: 3

[lightAndShadows.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/optics/lightAndShadows/lightAndShadows.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Obstacles and the source's position determine a shadow's appearance, direction, and size; a model enables qualitative predictions.

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelajahi bagaimana posisi benda dan sumber cahaya menghasilkan bayangan.

##### Menjelaskan Pembentukan Bayangan

[explainHowAShadowForms.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/optics/lightAndShadows/skills/explainHowAShadowForms.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate a shadow to the blocking of light by an opaque object.

**User-friendly description (id):** Jelaskan bagaimana benda yang tidak tembus cahaya menghalangi cahaya hingga terbentuk bayangan.

##### Memprediksi Perubahan Ukuran Bayangan

[predictChangesInShadowSize.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/optics/lightAndShadows/skills/predictChangesInShadowSize.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine how changing their relative positions affects shadow size.

**User-friendly description (id):** Pahami bagaimana memindahkan sumber cahaya atau benda mengubah ukuran bayangan.

##### Memprediksi Letak Bayangan

[predictThePositionOfAShadow.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/optics/lightAndShadows/skills/predictThePositionOfAShadow.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Predict where a shadow forms given the positions of the source and object.

**User-friendly description (id):** Prediksi di sisi mana sebuah benda akan muncul bayangannya.

#### Pemantulan Cahaya

Skills: 2

[lightReflection.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/optics/lightReflection/lightReflection.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A surface changes the direction of a light ray; mirrors provide a visible model of this behavior.

**User-friendly description (id):** Pelajari bagaimana cahaya berubah arah saat mengenai permukaan pemantul.

##### Memprediksi Arah Sinar Pantul
